final: WITH site_ratios AS (SELECT s.zoneregistry, s.insurstat, COUNT(*) AS mesh_count, AVG(m.facetresmm / NULLIF(m.geomdeltamm, 0)) AS avg_ratio FROM sites AS s JOIN scanmesh AS m ON m.zoneref = s.zoneregistry WHERE s.insurstat IS NOT NULL GROUP BY s.zoneregistry, s.insurstat), status_avgs AS (SELECT insurstat, AVG(avg_ratio) AS status_avg FROM site_ratios GROUP BY insurstat) SELECT sr.insurstat, AVG(sr.avg_ratio) AS above_avg_ratio, COUNT(*) AS site_count, AVG(sr.avg_ratio - sa.status_avg) AS avg_excess FROM site_ratios AS sr JOIN status_avgs AS sa ON sa.insurstat = sr.insurstat WHERE sr.avg_ratio > sa.status_avg GROUP BY sr.insurstat
